                               Town of Lakeport
                        NOTICE OF CANCELLATION
                           OF THE MEETING OF
              THE TOWN COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF LAKEPORT

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that the April 2, 2024 regular meeting of the Town
Council of the Town of Lakeport has been cancelled.

The next meeting of the Town Council is scheduled for Tuesday, April 16, 2024.
